title: Navi branch-reconciliation review package

plan.objective: Turn Navi's two historical production branches into an explicit canon decision without silently overwriting either branch.
steps: Review the robotic-fairy and organic leaf-fairy branches as separate evidence.
Compare face, body language, costume, wings, palette, role, and production history.
Choose global canon, production-specific variants, separate characters, or continued hold.
Record any rename and migration plan before permitting production use.

findings.message: Robotic-fairy and organic leaf-fairy branches are materially different and cannot be merged by inference.
Both branches remain historical production evidence until a decision is approved.

branches.description: White and dark robotic fairy with cyan face and four-wing language.
Teal-haired organic fairy with green leaf dress.

next_gate: Present the two branches and five decision options for explicit Character Canon approval.
